description: CSC3209 external benchmark derived from repository past papers and course-grounded model answers. The model answers are not official university marking schemes.

cases.question: Q1(a), first requirement
cases.full_context: Video game digital distribution services have gamers and publishers. Gamers want to be notified whenever a new game is available that matches the gamers' preference. Present a suitable architectural pattern with detailed justification.
cases.isolated_requirement: Gamers want to be notified whenever a new game is available that matches their preference. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.notes: Architectural/system-level event distribution; Observer is requested separately at implementation level in Q4.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), second requirement
cases.full_context: In a video game digital distribution system, gamers can communicate and chat among each other. Present a suitable architectural pattern with detailed justification.
cases.isolated_requirement: Gamers can communicate and chat among each other. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.notes: The repository model answer prefers P2P only under a direct/equal-peer interpretation and explicitly says centralized Client-Server chat is also possible. The paper does not state the decisive interaction mechanism.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), third requirement
cases.full_context: A video game store must allow gamers to store and check gaming progress and achievements through an online profile even if they change the PC they use. Present a suitable architectural pattern with detailed justification.
cases.isolated_requirement: Store and retrieve a gamer's authoritative online progress from different PCs. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.notes: Distributed clients request centrally managed profile state.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), gamer scenario G1
cases.full_context: During peak usage, a gamer submits a game-search request. The catalogue returns matching games, and 95 percent of searches must complete within 2 seconds. What top-level quality attribute does this scenario specify?
cases.isolated_requirement: 95 percent of game searches complete within 2 seconds. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Latency is a response measure/detail under Performance.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), gamer scenario G2
cases.full_context: While a gamer is viewing the store, one application server instance crashes. Traffic is redirected to a healthy instance within 5 seconds and the session continues. What top-level quality attribute is addressed?
cases.isolated_requirement: One instance crashes, traffic redirects, and service continues. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Fault, failover and recovery are details/mechanisms; Availability is the course category.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q3(a)
cases.full_context: The game platform must consume independently managed payment, identity or recommendation services over a network through published interfaces without depending on provider internals. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Independent network services cooperate through published service contracts. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: The decisive issue is independently managed service providers and published contracts.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q4(b)
cases.full_context: At implementation level, a game catalogue Subject must automatically notify a variable set of registered dependent notification objects when a matching new game is added. Which design pattern should be used?
cases.isolated_requirement: A Subject automatically updates registered dependent objects when its state changes. Which design pattern?
cases.notes: The paper explicitly asks for an implementation-level design pattern.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), first requirement
cases.full_context: A utilities management application must notify users whenever electricity consumption exceeds a specific threshold. Present a suitable architectural pattern with detailed justification.
cases.isolated_requirement: Notify interested users when electricity consumption crosses a threshold. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: Architectural/system-level event distribution.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), second requirement
cases.full_context: Users of a utilities application can pay bills through independently offered online banking and credit-card payment services. Present a suitable architectural pattern with detailed justification.
cases.isolated_requirement: Integrate independently managed online banking services through published network interfaces. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: External service-provider interoperability is decisive.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), third requirement
cases.full_context: A utilities app must allow users to store and track electricity usage and bill payments online via the Internet. Distributed clients request centrally managed account records. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Clients store and retrieve centrally managed utility records through request/reply over the Internet. Which pattern?
cases.notes: Client-initiated access to an authoritative online service.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), scenario U2
cases.full_context: Under peak monthly-billing load, a utility customer requests usage history and 95 percent of requests must complete within 2 seconds. What top-level quality attribute is specified?
cases.isolated_requirement: 95 percent of usage-history requests finish within 2 seconds. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Response time is a Performance measure.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q3(a)
cases.full_context: User devices or smart-energy gateways share anonymized local outage information. Each participant can initiate a request and provide its own locally observed information to others. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Each distributed participant requests information and provides its own resources as an equal. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: Symmetric request/provide roles are explicit.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q3(c)
cases.full_context: Several peers hold overlapping outage information. If one peer leaves or fails, a request can be redirected to another peer and useful service continues. Which top-level quality attribute may be enhanced?
cases.isolated_requirement: Another peer can continue providing an overlapping resource after one peer fails. Which top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Availability is the valid top-level course answer; overlapping resources are the precondition.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q4(c)
cases.full_context: At implementation level, an electricity-consumption Subject must notify registered UI and notification objects when its state crosses a configured threshold. Which design pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: One object changes state and automatically notifies a variable set of dependent objects. Which design pattern?
cases.notes: Implementation-level one-to-many object notification.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2024_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), first requirement
cases.full_context: An online trading platform displays the same real-time stock-price data through line charts, bar charts and other user-interface views. User input such as zooming must be handled while core application logic remains separate. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Multiple synchronized Views show the same Model while Controllers handle user input. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: Model/View/Controller roles are explicit.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), second requirement
cases.full_context: Users of an online trading platform want to be notified whenever a watched stock price reaches a specific target value so they can buy or sell. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Push an event to interested users whenever a watched stock reaches a target. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: System-level event notification.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), third requirement
cases.full_context: An online trading platform lets users buy stock through independently managed PayPal, banking and credit-card payment services. Which architectural pattern addresses this integration requirement?
cases.isolated_requirement: Consume external payment services through published contracts despite independent technologies. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: External provider interoperability.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), scenario T2
cases.full_context: An application-server instance fails during trading. Traffic is redirected to a healthy instance within 5 seconds and service continues with no more than one failed request. What top-level quality attribute is addressed?
cases.isolated_requirement: A server fails, traffic redirects, and trading service continues. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Service continuity under fault.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), scenario T3
cases.full_context: An unauthorized attacker attempts a protected trading operation. The system rejects the operation and records an audit event; all unauthorized operations must be rejected and logged. What top-level quality attribute is addressed?
cases.isolated_requirement: Reject and log every unauthorized trading operation. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Authorization is a Security concept, not the top-level QA answer.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q3
cases.full_context: A financial-data stream is transformed successively by independent Parse, Validate, Normalize and Enrich stages. Each stage consumes data, transforms it and forwards output through a connector. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Successive independent transformations of a data stream through filters and pipes. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: Staged stream transformation, not partitioned batch processing.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q4(c)
cases.full_context: At implementation level, airline-promotion objects must notify dependent UI or notification objects automatically when a relevant promotion is added or changes state. Which design pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Dependent objects react automatically when a Subject's promotion state changes. Which design pattern?
cases.notes: Implementation-level one-to-many notification.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), first requirement
cases.full_context: A healthcare insurance system shows a panel clinic location using an independently managed Google Maps capability inside the system through its published network API. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Consume an external mapping provider through a published network interface. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: External provider integration/interoperability.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), second requirement
cases.full_context: A healthcare insurance system lets web and mobile clients store and track insurance balances and claim details via the Internet. A centralized claims service maintains authoritative state and responds to requests. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Distributed clients request centrally managed insurance account records. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: Asymmetric request/reply with a central service.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), third requirement
cases.full_context: Users of a healthcare insurance system must be notified whenever a claim is approved or a new promotion becomes available. Interested channels receive events when the claims or promotion state changes. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Push notifications to changing recipients whenever a claim is approved. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: Architectural event distribution.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), scenario H1
cases.full_context: A claims-service instance fails during normal operation. The insurance system redirects traffic to a healthy instance and keeps claims access available within 5 seconds. What top-level quality attribute is addressed?
cases.isolated_requirement: Claims access continues after one service instance fails. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Availability is the course category.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), scenario H4
cases.full_context: A first-time insurance user attempts to submit a claim. The interface guides the user through the task, and 90 percent must complete it within 5 minutes without assistance. What top-level quality attribute is addressed?
cases.isolated_requirement: A first-time user completes a claim task quickly without assistance. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: The measure is user task success/learnability, not system response time.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q3
cases.full_context: An insurance claims application separates domain state and logic into a Model, presentation into multiple Views, and user-input mediation into Controllers. Views remain synchronized when the Model changes. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Model, View and Controller separate UI from application functionality. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: The three MVC roles are explicit.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q5(b)
cases.full_context: At implementation level, a claim-status Subject must notify registered notification and UI objects when a claim becomes approved. Which design pattern should be used?
cases.isolated_requirement: A Subject notifies registered dependent objects after its state changes. Which design pattern?
cases.notes: Object-level notification.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_August_2025_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), first requirement
cases.full_context: Users of an HPC platform want to be notified whenever a submitted task or workflow process has completed. The job subsystem emits a completion event to interested notification components. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Notify interested users whenever a submitted workflow completes. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: System-level completion events.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), second requirement
cases.full_context: An HPC platform allows Internet users to store and track submitted tasks and processed data. Browser clients request status and data from a centralized job-management service that maintains authoritative records. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Clients request centrally managed job and processed-data records over the Internet. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: Asymmetric request/reply.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Answers.md

cases.question: Q2(a), third requirement
cases.full_context: An HPC platform lets users pay fees or join plans for more computational power by consuming independently managed payment and billing capabilities through published network service interfaces. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Integrate external payment providers through published service contracts. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: External service-provider interoperability.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), scenario HPC1
cases.full_context: At peak platform load, an HPC user requests job status and 95 percent of interactive job-management requests must complete within 2 seconds. What top-level quality attribute is specified?
cases.isolated_requirement: 95 percent of job-status requests complete within 2 seconds. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Latency is the measure; Performance is the top-level category.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Answers.md

cases.question: Q1(a), scenario HPC2
cases.full_context: A compute or service node fails while HPC jobs run. The platform detects the failure, reschedules affected work to a healthy node and keeps the service accessible. What top-level quality attribute is addressed?
cases.isolated_requirement: A failed compute node is detected and work restarts elsewhere while service remains accessible. What top-level quality attribute?
cases.notes: Recovery is a mechanism/detail under Availability.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Answers.md

cases.question: Q3
cases.full_context: An online retailer analyzes billions of historical transaction records. The input is partitioned across parallel Map tasks, intermediate key/value data is shuffled and sorted, and Reduce tasks calculate totals. Which architectural pattern fits?
cases.isolated_requirement: Large batch data is partitioned into Map tasks, shuffled/sorted and combined by Reduce tasks. Which architectural pattern?
cases.notes: Partitioned parallel batch processing.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Answers.md

cases.question: Q4(c)
cases.full_context: Architectural documentation for the Map-Reduce scenario must explain the main diagram, define the elements and relations, show the system context, and document allowed variation. What documentation concept contains these sections?
cases.isolated_requirement: Primary Presentation, Element Catalog, Context Diagram and Variability Guide. What architecture documentation concept?
cases.notes: These are the core view-template sections.
cases.source: Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Exam.md; Learning Materials/Past Year Exam Papers/CSC3209_January_2026_Answers.md
